findings.evidence: QualificationLifecycleCaseWorkflow.TerminalBody accepts only Consumed manifests; QualificationLifecycleOriginalReader needs a definitive non-consumed held-manifest outcome for S3.hold-pin. Current workflow cannot reach that denial observation.

LookupRegistrationOriginalAsync requires and echoes an already-complete registration, but KeyEnvelopeBuilder generates the receipt during first wrap. The new test pre-wraps; first-response-loss recovery lacks the receipt it requires.
AbandonSuccessorAsync selects intents[0] including closed copy intents; native EnsureCompletionAsync rejects closed reservations even with an active retirement intent.

NativeArchiveCapacity.SaveAsync rewrites a ledger up to 32 MiB before releasing completion blocks; admission preserves only 64 KiB physical overhead. A near-full filesystem can strand admitted completions.

Recovery branches validate a top-level SubmitCommandRequest, but DispatchBinding compares its signed command only through payload/id/role-compatible domain. Tenant/aggregate/type/extensions can differ at the conditional admission.

DispatchBinding checks workload expiry/proof time before awaited archive writes; final CAS only rechecks the storage caller and authority expiry. The distinct workload/proof can expire before admission.

Custody-owner-call now bypasses the externalEffect CAS as read-only, and the receiver performs no post-handler current-head authorization. A grant revocation during native/control reads can precede return of a fresh proof.
NSubstitute was added directly and project references changed without the tracked dependency lock updates. The supported Release/package-reference locked restore reports NU1004.

BoundedRegularFile performs openat/statx and regular-file reads without a cancellable outer execution bound; cancellation checks cannot interrupt a stalled filesystem syscall and no storage-contract constraint prevents that path.

The installed constructor creates only DaprPhaseOwner instances. Their preflight delegates to DaprCohortRpc.call, whose queue wait has an absolute 30-second deadline independent of its daemon I/O worker; decoded proof/signature work is bounded. A permanently blocking substituted fake owner does not demonstrate a reachable installed executor-thread leak at the cited new pool.
